title: If you feel like giving up tonight…
paragraphs: If you feel like giving up tonight…
And He started something in you.

Even when you feel stuck.
Even when you fall back.
Even when your faith feels small.

You are not a failure.
You are a work in progress.

The same God who began your story
will finish it.

“He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion.”
— Philippians 1:6
🔥 Comment AMEN if God is still working in you.
